subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or a combined contract that supports both grouping and first-party reminder semantics?
rationale: The remaining work changes the durable cron schema and user-facing filtering across API, CLI, and UI, and the related metadata PR was closed for owner-reviewed API design rather than implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Shared classification contract
options.body: Add a durable cron classification/display shape that can carry typed purpose plus optional user labels, then expose filtering and bulk operations consistently.

options.title: Freeform tags only
options.body: Implement the issue as requested with optional string tags, accepting that reminders or plugins may need another typed field later.

options.title: Defer behind Reminders design
options.body: Keep this broad issue pending until the narrower Reminders UI/API direction chooses the first concrete classification shape.

recommendation.title: Shared classification contract
recommendation.body: Add a durable cron classification/display shape that can carry typed purpose plus optional user labels, then expose filtering and bulk operations consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the prior owner-reviewed design call on the related cron metadata PR, which is the closest maintainer signal for this API/protocol direction.
